sops.title: Central Commander Launch Protocol
sops.description: Ensure the coordinator always maximizes parallelism when launching agent teams. Eliminates the sequential-wave anti-pattern.

sops.title: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention Protocol
sops.description: Provides the coordinator with structured procedures for monitoring simultaneous agent teams, detecting problems early, and intervening.

sops.title: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention Protocol (v2)
sops.description: Version 2 of the monitoring and intervention protocol with updated procedures.

sops.title: Agent Prompt Engineering and Context Distribution
sops.description: Standardized procedures for crafting agent prompts and distributing context to maximize agent effectiveness in multi-team operations.

sops.title: Simultaneous Multi-Project Management Protocol
sops.description: Enables a central commander to run multiple independent projects simultaneously using hub-and-spoke monitoring.

sops.title: Infrastructure Audit and Mass Indexing Protocol
sops.description: Standardized procedure for conducting comprehensive repository audits including mass file indexing, tool inventory, bug tracking, and gap analysis.

sops.title: Cross-Team Data Flow and Report Consolidation
sops.description: Defines how data flows between teams within and across simultaneous projects. Covers report formats, consolidation pipelines, and handoff protocols.

sops.title: Cross-Team Data Flow, Handoff Protocol, and Quality Gates (v2)
sops.description: Version 2 with expanded handoff protocol and quality gates for cross-team data flow.

sops.title: Data Gathering Operations
sops.description: Standard procedure for selecting, configuring, and running data-gathering methods. Covers method selection, rate limiting, and validation.

sops.title: Market Research Operations
sops.description: Standard procedure for conducting market research, selecting analysis methods, logging stock picks, and tracking performance.

sops.title: Environment Setup for Fresh Deployment
sops.description: Standard procedure for setting up a fresh environment from scratch. Covers Python installation, dependency management, and Git configuration.

sops.title: Systematic Bug Fix Workflow
sops.description: Standard procedure for receiving bug reports, prioritizing them, making targeted fixes, verifying with tests, and documenting resolutions.

sops.title: Failure Recovery Runbook
sops.description: Comprehensive runbook for recovering from common failure modes in the multi-agent coordination system. Covers agent crashes, deadlocks, and data corruption.

sops.title: Evidence-Based Team Sizing and Composition
sops.description: Defines optimal team sizes and compositions based on empirical data from 28 team sessions with 132 agent instances.

sops.title: Anti-Recursion Protocol: Preventing Inward-Facing Gravity
sops.description: Prevents the pattern where teams spend their time building coordination infrastructure to build more coordination infrastructure.

sops.title: SOP Lifecycle Management: Creation, Review, Retirement
sops.description: Prevents SOP proliferation by defining when SOPs should be created, updated, and retired.

sops.title: Proto A Development Pipeline: Programming, Testing, Bug Fixing
sops.description: Define a repeatable pipeline for using Prototype A (JSONL + SQLite WAL) coordination to drive actual development work.

sops.title: Efficiency Patterns for Multi-Team Coordination
sops.description: Efficiency patterns and anti-patterns for multi-team AI coordination using Proto A. Based on observations from TEAM-0022 and prior sessions.

sops.title: Future Team Data Strategy and Knowledge Transfer
sops.description: Data storage strategy and knowledge transfer protocol for future AI teams. Defines what data to store, where to store it, and handoff checklists.

sops.title: Proto A Coordination Tool SOPs
sops.description: Standard Operating Procedures for all Proto A coordination tools. Designed for AI teams who have never seen the system before.

sops.title: File Creation & Naming Standards
sops.description: Establishes mandatory naming patterns, directory placement rules, and file size budgets for all repository resources. Addresses naming inconsistencies found in repository audit.

sops.title: Index Management & Maintenance
sops.description: Defines the universal index.json schema, mandates that indexes are generated artifacts, and establishes validation rules for consistent index structure.

sops.title: AI-Efficient Language Guide
sops.description: Defines controlled vocabulary, abbreviation dictionary, tag taxonomy, and token-efficient writing conventions to minimize boilerplate and use canonical terms.

sops.title: Optimal Team Sizing Protocol
sops.description: Data-driven decision framework for selecting team sizes based on empirically validated power law E=4.0*N^(-0.75). Translates 3247 data points into actionable sizing rules.

sops.title: Inter-Team Communication Protocol
sops.description: Defines when to use hub-and-spoke vs direct channels vs broadcast based on empirical data: hub 1.9x faster single-thread, channels 1.9x better p95 under concurrency.

sops.title: SQLite Contention Management
sops.description: Prevents SQLite WAL write contention from becoming the coordination bottleneck. Defines max 4 concurrent writers per database, partitioning strategies, backoff procedures, and monitoring thresholds based on empirical contention curve (96% throughput loss at 32 threads).

sops.title: Benchmark-Driven Development Process
sops.description: Establishes repeatable benchmarking process: baseline before changes, regression detection thresholds (correctness 0-tolerance, latency p95 <20% increase, throughput <15% decrease, tokens <10% increase), and result archival.

sops.title: Data Collection and Indexing Standards
sops.description: Standardizes three-tier index system (SUMMARY 79 tokens, INDEX_COMPACT 50 tokens/entry, full index 6093 tokens). Defines required metadata fields, naming conventions, cross-reference requirements, and data quality standards enabling 90.2% token savings.
